statements.text: Bounded systems are built of smaller bounded systems, so agents or selves exist at many nested scales, from cells to organisms and beyond.

sources.quote: autonomous systems are hierarchically composed of Markov blankets of Markov blankets
particles at one scale can only exist if there is a nonequilibrium steady-state density at a higher scale that entails Markov blankets of Markov blankets
much of the self-evidencing at one scale is absorbed into the fast, random fluctuations at the scale above
Selves can be nested and overlapping, cooperating and competing both laterally and across levels.

sources.locator: section Defining Individuation From a Cognitive Perspective
sources.quote: systems house multiple levels of coexisting coherent Selves

we advance a scale-free characterization of consciousness and cognition that regards basal systems, including synthetic constructs, as not only informative about the structure and function of experience in more complex systems
can be combined to create a new conscious agent.
